notes.title: Major Update ⚙️ Playtest ⚙️ - We Need Your Help!
notes.notes:
Hello there Guys and Gals!!

The next Major Update is almost here and coming in the end of August! However, this time it brings along some drastic changes in the core mechanics of the game.

Beta Playtest

While we are gettng everything perfectly ready for you, we’ve got a little favor to ask. We have a ready-to-play Playtest, and we would love to hear the opinion of each and everyone of you and find out if there are any issues we can avoid before we let the rest of the world play it. 

How to Switch to the Beta Playtest?

1. Select the game in your library. Then click on the ⚙️gear icon, then click Properties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/ff8a1fc496d64fd30935c8b21d1a0e6bb9ae0b2d.png

2. Now click on BETAS tab, and then select: playtest - playtest

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/2437b1ced9323c3728165e8c3dc94c8c79054731.png

Your game will update to the Beta Playtest where only the Playtest version will be available.

You can always go back to the original game by doing the same and selecting the None branch which will bring you back to the previous version's normal Early Access game mode.

Head to our  Discord  for any bugs faced.

Wish you a gut-wrenching run! 🐸 🦀 🌀

‘till next time,
your friends at indieGiant🤟🏻

notes.title: MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE BLEUMER🪼- OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Howdy partner! 🪼 🐊 🦀

Major Content Update🪼BLEUMER🪼 is LIVE NOW!

WILL YOU DESCEND INTO THE ABYSSAL REALM?
It’s the biggest content update yet, so without further ado here’s what the full package offers:

Where we at?

We are descending into the abyssal realm, right under the surface. The latest addition is the BLEUMER Map🪼  which brings its own challenges and fun. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/556f8813932be6b99247d01c9f0c59d3f0b3d69d.gif

Who's the new face?

A New Character and its slick New Weapon with perks on its own is here to wipe the new undersea challenges off the new realm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/ef9acfa0bde2c6abcf6cd694d8c1a9582373f96d.gif

Who are these undersea challenges in question?

Nothing other than 16 New Enemies and 2 Bosses of course.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/104ba7279c059ec5277c703930f3df81bac16caa.gif

The Enemies just inflate to explode around you, some throw stuff or some even jump at you, some actually tail-slap you.

On the other side, Bosses try to take you down quite literally by clenching or raining fire over you. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/72f892a31de8fe581bed32292187b5506398d879.gif

How to beat them?

Easy as pie. Just include any of the 5 New Weapons in your builds, or just mix and match all 5 of them together or whatever, it’s the way you want it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/c83dc7a5c26f037f455ce0eaa37dcc9ac0d8b3c2.gif

notes.title: Patch Notes - V0.3.3
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/9b04fea7cdf45d524c5625e6e823bfa99dbe2848.jpg

We have been working now and then listening to everything coming from you, and working on creating a better version for you all to have a better gameplay experience. Thanks to all your support, the game has gotten so much better. 

💥Our Demo with the SURVIVAL MODE IS OUT now!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43546614/308a67789dff6b0e71743545680b200bdb7fa8be.png

The game wouldn't be where it is now without your continuous support and we are really grateful for having you in our development journey.
Please keep them coming along the way! 

Here's what we have been working on:

FEATURES
💥Survival Mode activated.
💥Red Pill added: life regenerating pick-ups that can drop when the player breaks orange crystals.
💥Blue Pill added: pick-up that pulls the XPs towards the player, which may fall when they break the orange crystals.
💥New bosses have been added to the game, with a total of 4 different bosses.
💥New enemies joined the party.
💥Bounty Drops added: bosses now drop bounty drops when they die.
💥The player's main weapon: a shotgun, can now be upgraded, increasing its range and projectile count.
💥Auto-shooting added.
💥Auto-shooting toggle option added.

FIXED
💥In-game shake on/off bug fixed.
💥The problem with the volume changing after adjusting the volume in options fixed.
💥An issue with critical damager buffs on powerups fixed.
💥A  bug when the menu screen opens during the upgrade screen fixed.

CHANGES
💥Item and weapon variety will increase in the upcoming updates; until then, some changes on synergies were made to motivate creating different types of builds,  all active and passive weapons have a synergy class now.
💥In-Game music changes.
💥Damage pop-up animations improved, and critical damages more clear now.

BALANCE
💥All enemy health-damage stats reworked.
💥Dash cooldown time shortened.
💥Player walking speed increased.
💥Power-Up prices updated.

notes.title: Patch Notes - V0.3.25
notes.notes:
We have been keeping up with all your feedback, we appreciate all of them.  Thank you for reporting.

Fixed
- The firing problem that the flame thrower firing under the ground.
- The direction problem of the bullets fired off the droids' weapons.
- After the player starts the level, landing multiple times bug.
- Save load bugs.
- UI disappearance on widescreens.

Features
- New cursor added.
- Dash icon added; lots of players reported that the character was too slow, and we realized that they didn't know there was a dash feature in the game.
- FPS limit is set to 240.
- The player doesn't have to click the left mouse button, there is automatic firing now.
- After going into the game, you had to go to the menu for the options, now you can also go to options in the game.
- We realized that after firing the shotgun, it disturbed some players, now there is a button in the options for turning it off and it is up to the player.

Balance
- The random events choices.
